events.title: 블랙번 로버스 cut 맨체스터 유나이티드's lead at the top of the Premier League to two points after beating them 2–0 at Ewood Park , three months after United had established a 16-point lead. Alan Shearer scores both of 블랙번 로버스's goals. In the relegation battle, 올덤 애슬레틱 give themselves a fresh boost by beating QPR 4–1 at Boundary Park , while 에버턴's relegation woes deepen when they lose 5–1 to 셰필드 웬즈데이 at Hillsborough .

에버턴 are pushed further into the relegation mire with a 3–0 home defeat by 블랙번 로버스, who are kept off the top by 맨체스터 유나이티드's 3–2 home win over 올덤 애슬레틱. 토트넘 홋스퍼 are still in danger of relegation after suffering a 4–1 home defeat to 웨스트햄 유나이티드. Leeds beat QPR 4–0 at Loftus Road .
A thrilling East Midlands derby at Filbert Street sees 레스터 시티 and 더비 카운티 draw 3-3 in the Division One promotion race. At the opposite end of the table, 왓퍼드 win 4–3 at Peterborough.

첼시 beat 루턴 타운 2–0 in the FA Cup semi-final to reach their first FA Cup final since 1970. In the league, the drama of the day comes as 사우샘프턴 boost their survival bid with a dramatic 5–4 win over 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road . 맷 르티시에 scores a hat-trick for the Saints, while Chris Sutton scores twice for the Canaries. 에버턴, meanwhile, give their own survival bid a boost with a 1–0 away win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드, with Tony Cottee scoring against his old club.

A late equaliser by 마크 휴스 forces a replay for 맨체스터 유나이티드 as they draw 1–1 with 올덤 애슬레틱 in the FA Cup semi-final, on the same day that 에리크 캉토나 (suspended for today's game) is voted PFA Player of the Year – the first foreign player to receive this accolade.

Alan Shearer scores his 30th league goal of the season in 블랙번 로버스's 1–0 home league win over 애스턴 빌라 to put 블랙번 로버스 level on points with 맨체스터 유나이티드, three months after 16 points separated the two teams.
아스널 reach the final of the European Cup Winners' Cup with a 2-1 aggregate win over 파리 FC St Germain .
맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 올덤 애슬레틱 4–1 in the FA Cup semi-final replay at Maine Road.

윔블던 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 1–0 in the Premier League but 블랙번 로버스 miss the chance to go top by losing 3–1 at 사우샘프턴, a result which is a big boost for Alan Ball's men in their bid for survival. In Division One, 크리스털 팰리스 make promotion almost certain with a 1–0 win at Luton.
크리스털 팰리스's promotion is confirmed when 밀월 - one of two teams who were still capable of finishing above them - draw 2–2 at home to second placed 노팅엄 포리스트.

The Football League confirms that no team will be relegated to the GM Vauxhall Conference this year, as none of the teams in the top half of the Conference (which, curiously, includes former League members 사우스포트 ) have a ground which meets the criteria for admission to the League. The recent requirement that all clubs must have a stadium holding at least 6,000 fans (1,200 or more seated) and must own their own stadium is the result of the collapse of Maidstone United at the start of last season; they had won promotion to the Football League in 1989 but had no home of their own at the time and went on to spend a large sum of money on purchasing a piece of land with the intention of building a stadium there, only to be refused planning permission to build the stadium. This leaves 노샘프턴 타운 and 달링턴 , who are both well adrift at the bottom of Division Three, fighting only the dishonour of placing as the League's bottom club. Northampton are in the process of building a new stadium to replace the County Ground later this year.
Edgar Davids makes his debut for the Netherlands national team in the friendly match against the Republic of Ireland (0–1) in Tilburg .

에리크 캉토나 returns from his five-match ban in style by scoring both of 맨체스터 유나이티드's goals in the Manchester derby at Old Trafford , which United win 2–0, going three points ahead of 블랙번 로버스 with four games remaining. Swindon's relegation is confirmed with a 4–2 home defeat to 윔블던. 입스위치 타운 are still in danger of going down after losing 5–0 at 셰필드 웬즈데이. Oldham miss an opportunity to climb back out of the relegation zone by losing 3–2 at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
블랙번 로버스 are held to a 1–1 draw at home by QPR, denting their title bid just as 맨체스터 유나이티드 look to be recapturing their form.
A Dean Holdsworth hat-trick gives 윔블던 a 3–0 home league win over 올덤 애슬레틱, who fall further into relegation trouble.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 move closer to a UEFA Cup place by beating 애스턴 빌라 5–1, and 맨체스터 유나이티드 move closer to the title with a 2–0 win at Leeds, placing them potentially four days away from winning the title. 블랙번 로버스 keep their title hopes alive with a 2–1 win at 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 노팅엄 포리스트 are on the brink of joining 크리스털 팰리스 for an immediate return to the Premier League with a 2–0 win at 더비 카운티 leaving them needing just two points from their final three games to be sure of promotion.

April draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still top of the league, though leading by just two points with a game in hand over 블랙번 로버스, the only team who now stand a mathematical chance of catching them. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 아스널 and 리즈 유나이티드 complete the top five, which a resurgent 윔블던 would now be in had it not been for their weaker form earlier on in the season. 스윈던 타운, meanwhile, have had their relegation confirmed as they occupy bottom place with a mere 27 points and just four wins so far this season, although they did record a first away win in the top flight today by beating QPR 3–1 at Loftus Road. 올덤 애슬레틱 and 셰필드 유나이티드 complete the bottom three, while 사우샘프턴, 에버턴, 입스위치 타운, 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 맨체스터 시티 are still under threat of relegation. 크리스털 팰리스 and 노팅엄 포리스트 will be playing Premier League football next season after sealing promotion from Division One, a year after relegation. The playoff zone is occupied by 트랜미어 로버스, 레스터 시티, 더비 카운티 and 밀월, but there is still a chance of 노츠 카운티 or 울버햄프턴 원더러스 ousting 밀월 from the playoff places. The last game is played in front of 리버풀's Spion Kop before it is rebuilt as an all-seater stand. 노팅엄 포리스트's promotion was secured today with a 3–2 win at doomed Peterborough.
